::: {.profile-intro}
Hi, I'm Pablo. I'm from Ecuador and currently live in Campinas, Brazil, where I'm pursuing a Master's in Statistics at the [University of Campinas (UNICAMP)](https://www.unicamp.br/).

My main interests are **probability theory and stochastic processes**, especially their connections with **ergodic theory and dynamical systems**. I'm particularly interested in processes with infinite memory, and I also work on questions involving stochastic partial differential equations.

Outside mathematics, I enjoy **football and music**.

[Get in touch](mailto:p218730@dac.unicamp.br){.btn .btn-outline-primary} [GitHub](https://github.com/pabzun){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

## What I'm working on

My current research asks how the distant past influences a stochastic process, and under what conditions different pasts lead to the same long-term behavior. I study these questions through compatible probability laws in infinite-memory shift systems, using Hellinger-type criteria.

[More about my research →](research.html)

## A little background

I studied Statistics at **Escuela Superior Politécnica del Litoral (ESPOL)** in Guayaquil, Ecuador, graduating in 2025, before continuing my studies at UNICAMP. My work has included spatial statistics, selective inference, and research software. I also work as a teaching assistant at UNICAMP.

[Research & previous projects](research.html) · [Teaching](teaching.html) · [Manuscripts & thesis](publications.html)

- **16 November 2026 — ESPOL, Ecuador.** I've been selected as a student honoree for the **seventh edition of Cuartiles Mayores**. The recognition ceremony is scheduled for this date. [More details](posts/cuartiles-mayores/index.html).
